name: EPM_User-Writable Path Privilege Elevation Activity
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: EPM_User-Writable Path Privilege Elevation Activity
// Vendor: BeyondTrust
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with EPM_User-Writable Path Privilege Elevation Activity.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0004 - Privilege Escalation
// Technique: T1548 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = beyondtrust_epm_raw 

| filter is_epm_event = true
| filter is_epm_privilege_event = true
| filter epm_event_code in (100, 112)

| alter
    epm_process_command_line = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.command_line"),
    epm_process_title = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.title"),
    epm_parent_process_name = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.name"),
    epm_parent_process_path = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.executable"),
    epm_hosted_file_path = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.HostedFile.path"),
    epm_hosted_file_sha256 = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.HostedFile.hash.sha256"),
    process_path_lc = lowercase(process_path),
    hosted_file_path_lc = lowercase(epm_hosted_file_path)

// High-risk writable paths observed or operationally relevant
| filter
    process_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(downloads|desktop|appdata\\\\local\\\\temp|appdata\\\\roaming\\\\temp)\\\\.*"
    or process_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\(temp|windows\\\\temp)\\\\.*"
    or process_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\programdata\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\temp\\\\.*"
    or hosted_file_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(downloads|desktop|appdata\\\\local\\\\temp|appdata\\\\roaming\\\\temp)\\\\.*"
    or hosted_file_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\(temp|windows\\\\temp)\\\\.*"
    or hosted_file_path_lc ~= "^c:\\\\programdata\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\temp\\\\.*"

| fields
    _time,
    epm_event_code,
    event_type,
    event_message,
    risk_level,
    endpoint_name,
    endpoint_id,
    endpoint_ip,
    epm_username,
    user_domain,
    process_name,
    process_path,
    epm_process_command_line,
    epm_process_title,
    epm_parent_process_name,
    epm_parent_process_path,
    epm_hosted_file_path,
    epm_hosted_file_sha256
description: Detectar processos que exigiram elevação ou receberam direitos administrativos quando executados de diretórios graváveis pelo usuário ou temporários. Aplica Event IDs 100/112 e testa tanto process_path quanto HostedFile.path contra diretórios de maior risco; AppData\Local\Programs foi deliberadamente excluído por alto volume legítimo.
alert_description: Foi identificada atividade de privilégio para o processo $process_name executado a partir do caminho gravável $process_path no endpoint $endpoint_name , pelo usuário $epm_username . O SOC deve validar a origem, assinatura e legitimidade do arquivo.
